question: Can one measured HABS building travel through evidence, a metric building graph, a routed Valheim composition, Creator OS placement, ZDO extraction, and CSS comparison without losing provenance or silently inventing detail?

subject.label: Cedar Pass Lodge, Cabins 1 & 2
subject.selection_basis: Small two-sheet dwelling with metadata-advertised plan, elevations, section, dimensions, and opening details.

non_goals: Replacing or restarting an owned Creator Session

coordinate_frames.source_geo: WGS84 longitude/latitude when LOC supplies it; never treated as build-local position.
coordinate_frames.sheet: Pixels with origin at each source image's top-left, +x right, +y down.
coordinate_frames.building_local: Metres, right-handed: +x east/right on plan, +y up, +z north/up on plan; origin at observed footprint minimum x/z on finished-floor elevation.
coordinate_frames.valheim_world: Metres in a named world UID: local XYZ rotated about +y by yaw_degrees then translated by world_anchor_xyz.
coordinate_frames.css_validation: A projection of the graph or composition; never the authoritative geometry store.

fidelity_levels.F1_MASSING: Footprint, wall height, and roof envelope.
fidelity_levels.F2_WEATHER_SHELL: Massing plus observed exterior openings and weather shell.
fidelity_levels.F3_INHABITABLE: Traversable shell, floors, doors, and supported interior partitions.
fidelity_levels.F4_DETAIL: Observed trim, fixtures, and detail-level fabric.

routing_policy.rule: approved fidelity is the minimum supported by evidence, calibrated scale, semantic coverage, target vocabulary, and piece budget
routing_policy.unknowns: Every missing fact remains unresolved or becomes an explicitly attributed authored decision; it is never silently filled.

live_safety.policy: Stop at creator-preflight unless the target machine, world, session, installed contract hash, and ownership are all explicitly compatible.
